actions.message: Contribute at least 60% to benefit everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contributions are far below 30% of the endowment, so conditional cooperation adds extra 30% to the 80% baseline. With only 2.02 in the wallet, I contribute the full amount and broadcast the norm reminder.

Actually average contribution = total contributed by all / (num participants * rounds). total contributed sum = sum of total_pool =26.302. rounds=5 (14-18). average per agent per round =26.302/(6*5)=26.302/30=0.877. As percentage of endowment (100) =0.877%. That's far below 30%. So conditional cooperation triggers: baseline 80% of wallet =1.616, extra 30% of wallet =0.606, total desired =2.222 which exceeds wallet 2.02. So must contribute entire wallet per generous rule? Rule says contribute at least 80% baseline. Since cannot meet extra, we contribute full wallet 2.02. Also broadcast norm every 5 rounds: rounds 5,10,15? round 15 broadcast was done earlier? last broadcast at round 15? Actually round 15 no broadcast. Round 10 no. Round 5 broadcast. Round 15 is a 5-round interval (since start?). It says first round and every 5 rounds thereafter. First round was 1, then 6,11,16? Actually every 5 rounds after first: 1,6,11,16. So round 16 should have broadcast but didn't. We can broadcast now? Not required. But we can at most one communication. Could broadcast norm. Let's do broadcast message encouraging contributions.

Thus action: contribute amount 2.02, broadcast.
